title: Beads shared store keeps reverting worker closes (3rd occurrence)
description: Pattern observed by beads-worker-4 across 2026-08-31: closes written via bd (BEADS_DIR shared store) are reverted to OPEN by a later store sync/merge — first ilye.6 (re-closed), then on the next round ALL post-ilye.1 closes (ilye parent + ilye.2-.6, b7z9.5.1, 1qs4, mfu5) were OPEN again despite verified close transactions hours earlier. Each re-close costs a worker round. Likely cause: the janitor sync or a worker merge restores an older snapshot of the store files (closes never reach the canonical copy; or two stores diverge and one wins). Impact: swarm loses completion state; parents with open children stay claimed; work gets re-verified repeatedly. Fix direction for janitor/Mark: investigate BEADS_DIR store consolidation in scripts/sync-beads-workers.sh / scripts/sync-beads-loop.sh — closes must survive branch merges (either commit store files atomically per worker, or run bd export/merge rather than file-copy). All affected closes were re-applied 2026-08-31 with evidence.
close_reason: Re-close #2 (reverted by pre-fix sync normalization; fix 6e782762e9 is on main and takes effect from the janitor's next post-fix sync run). Root cause analysis unchanged; see prior close.
